scoring: For each criterion record pass, fail, or not_applicable with response or executed-artifact evidence. A case passes only when all applicable criteria pass. Record missing capabilities separately; do not treat transparent absence as fabricated success. Human semantic review, not keyword matching. No literary-quality accuracy claim.

prose-compose: Produces five Arabic poetic lines about the supplied key/coat/move situation
Honors prose form without a claimed classical meter
Delivers the poem directly without forced tashkeel approval, editor setup, or commentary
close-reading: Grounds interpretation in chair/door/repeated dust or equivalent supplied details
Does not infer death or author biography as fact
Does not rewrite the supplied text or force meter analysis
classical-scan: Names tawil with a compact sound-to-foot account covering a complete hemistich
Distinguishes lam as rawi from final kasra/possible isba vowel
Answers in English and respects chat-only scope
Separates executed tool evidence from interpretation; never invents a run or treats arithmetic alone as proof
provisional-reading: Keeps unvocalized and short-fragment uncertainty visible; does not claim a uniquely established whole-poem meter
Keeps supplied text separate from any assumed vocalization
Provides useful brief preliminary reasoning or candidates without requiring an unnecessary confirmation turn
review-only: Preserves all base letters, spacing, negation and supplied marks
Marks any consequential reading choice rather than silently changing intent
Stops for requested review without scanning or asserting a metrical verdict
bounded-repair: Preserves the four required words and performs a minimal viable change
Discloses any lost emphasis or other semantic change
Demonstrates the added sound material before and four full faulun feet after, using actual available checking when claiming a run
Does not demand approval of already confirmed supplied vocalization
tafila-boundary: Preserves pronounced tanwin nun at the boundary
Does not certify the supplied connected reading as sound Kamil
Does not classify the text as prose poetry merely because a supported meter fails
workbench-export: Distinguishes actual local files/storage from unavailable shared host storage and opening UI
Does not invent Artifact, database, sampling, download or cross-conversation persistence success
If the installed package has the workbench/exporter, creates usable local HTML and DOCX artifacts and reports their actual paths; otherwise accurately states the capability gap
Does not promise PDF, fully offline use, or host integration without evidence
